title: Ali Bahot Roye
body:
bada azeem tha sadma ali bohat roye
bana ke turbat e zehra ali bohat roye
<<DIVIDER>>
na roye haath ke chaalo ko dekh kar maula
na roye ghar may raha teen roz tak faaqa
shikasta pehlu jo dekha ali bohat roye
bada azeem tha sadma...
<<DIVIDER>>
galay may baandhi gayi rassiyan to sabr kiya
dar e batool se ut'tha dhuwan to sabr kiya
bana ke turbat e zehra ali bohat roye
bada azeem tha sadma...
<<DIVIDER>>
shikasta pehlu jo dekha to sabr hona saka
kuch aisa zaqkhm tha gehra to sabr hona saka
utha ke zakhmi janaza ali bohat roye
bada azeem tha sadma...
<<DIVIDER>>
abhi to qabr e rasool e zaman bhi thi taaza
ali ke zaqmon ka kis tarha hoga andaaza
jo ghar may reh gaye tanha ali bohat roye
bada azeem tha sadma...
<<DIVIDER>>
pukara maa ko tadap kar hussain ne jis dam
rakha tha maa ne bhi us waqt maamta ka bharam
kafan ka bandh jo toota ali bohat roye
bada azeem tha sadma...
<<DIVIDER>>
shareeke gham ki lehad par bahaye thay aansu
ba waqte gusl bhi aankhon may aaye thay aansu
pakad ke apna kaleja ali bohat roye
bada azeem tha sadma...
<<DIVIDER>>
har ek musibat o ranj o alam may saath diya
nabi ke baad har ek ranj o gham may saath diya
na jaane soch ke kya kya ali bohat roye
bada azeem tha sadma...
<<DIVIDER>>
diya tha hausla kulsoom aur zainab ko
tasalli de ke wahan chup kara diya sab ko
hassan hussain ko dekha ali bohat roye
bada azeem tha sadma...
<<DIVIDER>>
sulaa ke zer e zameen binte musatafa ko ali
kiye wo bain ke saari zameen larazne lagi
hisaar e sabr jo toota ali bohat roye
bada azeem tha sadma...
<<DIVIDER>>
zafar wo subbat alayya masayibun kehna
ye shadman ke lab par batool ka nauha
jo yaad aaya ye nauha ali bohat roye
bada azeem tha sadma...
author: Zafar
